model: 12 cells, m=3 per family, R=F=1, k fixed, natural length fixed
assumptions: Straight spring fibers; optimistic network, not a continuum cloth solution. No contact, friction, thickness or stitch mechanics. Clamps advance each family by +/- beta on every successive plate.

scan.stop: First slack family or nonpositive Hessian eigenvalue
scan.strain_limit: Maximum fiber strain over the entire connected sampled branch
